scripts.start: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs && node scripts/generate-wasm-modules.mjs && expo start --web
scripts.export: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs && bun scripts/generate-og.ts && node scripts/generate-wasm-modules.mjs && expo export --platform web
scripts.deploy: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs && bun scripts/generate-og.ts && node scripts/generate-wasm-modules.mjs && expo export --platform web && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && npx --yes eas-cli deploy --prod --non-interactive
scripts.serve:e2e: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs && node scripts/generate-wasm-modules.mjs && expo export --platform web && expo serve --port ${PORT:-8082}
